race.comment: EUPHORIC MISS (4) can go one better after leading and being beaten just over a length at this track last start. Gets in well again at the weights with the claimer sticking and gets top nod. FLYING GISELLE (5) was poor when last as a well-supported favourite, but her Prairie second before that and stronger and prior form keep her firmly in play. ORACLE OF OMAHA (3) sat on speed and battled on gamely into the placings when resuming at Cloncurry. Fitter now and doesn't have to improve much to get the job done this time. IT'S A POWER (8) is knocking on the door and should be at her top now fourth-up. No shock to see her fighting out the finish.
